keyPoints.en: Pure water: boils at 100 °C and freezes at 0 °C.
keyPoints.bm: Air tulen: mendidih pada 100 °C dan membeku pada 0 °C.

keyPoints.en: Evaporation depends on temperature, humidity, wind and surface area.
keyPoints.bm: Penyejatan bergantung pada suhu, kelembapan, angin dan luas permukaan.

meaning.en: Liquid turning to gas at the surface.

question.en: Why does washing dry faster on a windy day?
question.bm: Mengapa pakaian cepat kering pada hari berangin?

tip.en: Boiling happens throughout a liquid; evaporation only at its surface.
tip.bm: Pendidihan berlaku di seluruh cecair; penyejatan hanya di permukaan.

keyPoints.en: Solubility is the mass of solute that dissolves in a solvent at a given temperature.
keyPoints.bm: Keterlarutan ialah jisim zat terlarut yang larut dalam pelarut pada suhu tertentu.

keyPoints.en: Solutions can be dilute, concentrated or saturated.
keyPoints.bm: Larutan boleh jadi cair, pekat atau tepu.

keyPoints.en: Heat, stirring and small particles speed up dissolving.
keyPoints.bm: Haba, kacauan dan zarah kecil mempercepat pelarutan.

question.en: Which dissolves faster: sugar crystals or fine sugar?
question.bm: Yang mana cepat larut: hablur gula atau gula halus?

tip.en: Solubility and rate of dissolving are different ideas.
tip.bm: Keterlarutan dan kadar melarut adalah idea berbeza.

keyPoints.en: Chlorine and fluoride are added before supply.
keyPoints.bm: Klorin dan fluorida ditambah sebelum dibekalkan.

keyPoints.en: We must save water and protect its sources.
keyPoints.bm: Kita mesti menjimatkan air dan melindungi sumbernya.

tip.en: Remember: Screen, Coagulate, Settle, Filter, Disinfect.
tip.bm: Ingat: Saring, Kental, Mendap, Tapis, Nyahkuman.
